notificationLab.information.title: MellowYak information
notificationLab.information.body: Local monitoring is active. No protected behavior regression is currently confirmed.
notificationLab.warning.title: MellowYak warning
notificationLab.warning.body: A local check needs attention. Review the available evidence before continuing.
notificationLab.high.title: MellowYak high-priority alert
notificationLab.high.body: Required verification is incomplete. Completion remains blocked until the missing check is resolved.
notificationLab.regression.title: Regression detected — critical
notificationLab.regression.body: A protected behavior failed repeatedly after a change. Completion is blocked and local evidence is available.
notificationLab.recovery.title: Recovery required — critical
notificationLab.recovery.body: MellowYak could not prove a complete rollback. Open the local recovery details before editing affected files.
notificationLab.error.title: Local engine error
notificationLab.error.body: Monitoring could not continue safely. Project source was not modified; open MellowYak for recovery guidance.
notificationLab.resolved.title: Regression resolved
notificationLab.resolved.body: The protected behavior passed again with current local evidence. Review the result before closing the incident.
